On October 13, 2023, Microsoft Corporation ("Microsoft") completed its acquisition of Activision Blizzard, Inc. (the "Company"). Microsoft Corporation paid $95.00 per share in cash.

The Company intends to file a certification on Form 15 to apply for the deregistration of the shares under Section 12(b) of the Exchange Act. As a result, the shares that previously traded under the symbol “ATVI” will no longer be listed on Nasdaq.
